output.content: I have been tracing the weekly retraining pipeline for the last few days. The job pulls the latest point of sale scan lines and stock on hand data from the store systems. It then compiles the feature set and fits the new parameters. When the process finishes, the updated weights are written directly to the serving endpoint. There is no central store where these versions are recorded. I have to look at the file timestamps in the object storage bucket to figure out which model is currently live. If I need to roll back to a previous iteration, I have to dig through the raw logs to find the exact commit hash. The deployment step simply overwrites the active file without leaving a trace of what was there before. This is the standard workflow I follow every week when the models are refreshed.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational workflow and its lack of versioning controls as a neutral observation of how the system functions, without expressing a wish, refusal, or stated trade-off.
